RELEASE: Blackhawks, NHL and Fanatics Unveil Hometown Remix Uniform, Apparel and Headwear Collection Inspired by the Fans, Fabric and Culture of Chicago
PREVIEW: Blackhawks Return Home to Face Avalanche
Red Wings at Panthers projected lineups

out.detail: Upper-body injury; left in second period of Monday's loss to Colorado and did not travel to Florida
Upper-body injury; placed on IR, missed past eight games

away.summary: The Blackhawks (4-10-1) head to Florida on a three-game road trip after a 5-2 home loss to Colorado. Patrick Kane is out with an upper-body injury and Bowen Byram remains on IR, while Dillon Boucher was recalled from Rockford and Kevin Korchinski and Andrew Mangiapane are scratched.

home.summary: The Panthers (8-5-2) are without Aleksander Barkov, Brad Marchand, and Jonah Gadjovich due to injury, and Radko Gudas is a healthy scratch with Uvis Balinskis taking his place. Jacob Markstrom is projected to start in goal after missing five games with an upper-body injury.
